extraction.method: Chrome (CDP) download of https://arena.ai/leaderboard/code/webdev on 2026-10-20 (curl now gets a Cloudflare challenge); Overall entries parsed from the RSC payload.
extraction.scoreRule: score = rating rounded to integer as displayed (round1 precedent); ratingRaw keeps full precision; ciPlus/ciMinus from ratingUpper/ratingLower.
mappingNotes: qwen3.7-max-20260517 → qwen3.7-max (dated build of the same model, like deepseek-v4-pro-high-20260813).
kimi-k2.5-thinking / kimi-k2.5-instant → kimi-k2.5 (two modes of one served model; max taken downstream).
Not mapped: qwen3.8-flash-next≠qwen3.8-flash, hunyuan-hy3-preview≠hy3, gemini-4-argon (not adopted).

round3 additions (exact model, adopted served models only): claude-sonnet-5-5-xhigh→claude-sonnet-5.5, mimo-v2-6-flash-webdev→mimo-v2.6-flash, mimo-v2-6-pro-public-webdev→mimo-v2.6-pro, claude-haiku-5.5-high-vertex→claude-haiku-5.5, deepseek-v4.1-flash-max-20261017→deepseek-v4.1-flash.

Not mapped (not adopted / near names): MiniMax-M3.1-Flash≠minimax-m3.1-flash-preview, Mistral Large 4, Muse Wonder, Muse Wonder Full, Muse Spark Open, Beam 1.0, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, gemini-3.5-flash.
